lines.text: Elisha came to Damascus while Ben-hadad was sick, and the king told Hazael to take a gift and inquire of the LORD.
Hazael met Elisha with a gift of forty camel loads of every good thing from Samaria.
Elisha said Ben-hadad would surely recover but would in fact die, then he wept because of the evil Hazael would do to the Israelites.
Elisha said the LORD had shown him that Hazael would be king over Israel.
Hazael told the king he would surely recover, but the next day he spread a wet cloth over the king's face, and Hazael reigned.
